params.name: CNV Segments
params.desc: Final allelic-ratio + tangent-normalized copy-number segments per tumor/normal pair

cols.name: Bin Count
cols.desc: Approximate number of bins/probes in the segment

cols.name: Segment Source
cols.desc: 'original' (allelic-ratio segmentation) or 'recovered' (rescued from tangent outlier recovery)

cols.name: Log2 Signal
cols.desc: Segment-level mean log2 tangent-normalized signal; positive suggests gain, negative suggests loss

params.name: Per-Bin Processed Counts
params.desc: Per-bin read depth, allelic fractions, and tangent-normalized signal underlying the CNV segments

cols.name: Locus Key
cols.desc: CONTIG:START join key linking allelic-count and tangent-normalized rows

cols.name: Read Count
cols.desc: Raw read depth in this bin

cols.name: SNP Count
cols.desc: Number of heterozygous SNPs supporting this bin's allelic-fraction estimate

cols.name: Allelic Fraction Ratio
cols.desc: Derived allelic-ratio feature used in segmentation

cols.name: Cumulative Start
cols.desc: Genome-wide cumulative start coordinate, for whole-genome plotting

cols.name: Cumulative End
cols.desc: Genome-wide cumulative end coordinate, for whole-genome plotting

cols.name: Allelic-Ratio Segment ID
cols.desc: ID of the allelic-ratio-based segment this bin was assigned to

cols.name: Tangent Segment ID
cols.desc: ID of the tangent (CBS)-based segment this bin was assigned to
